title: Reference-consistent complete gradient and acquired Hessian replacement
summary: Extend the directional assembly to complete analytic Hessians acquired at the declared common reference, retaining forces, mixed terms and joint operator transport.
gates: Freeze reference geometry, atom order, isotopologue, masses, normal-mode vectors, normalization, units, parent tensors and electronic level including triples scaling.

Acquire energies along complete frozen normal directions, never reinterpret individual primitive coordinate displacements as normal modes. One explicitly authorized +/- pair is allowed; retain its finite-step gradient and curvature estimates and report their numerical qualification separately.

Install BOTH high-level gradient and curvature as target minus current exactly once. No diagnostic-only discard of electronic slopes. Preserve unacquired mixed derivatives and source higher derivatives.

At a nonstationary reference retain the linear potential. A Hessian pullback includes F1 times the second coordinate derivative, and the fourth potential derivative includes F1 times the fourth coordinate derivative. Missing coordinate-map derivatives are fatal.

Potential assembly is not spectral qualification. Stationary VPT2 is blocked until a qualified stationary reference exists; otherwise use a qualified nonstationary variational Hamiltonian retaining linear forces.

Recentering or changing the Hamiltonian coordinates requires joint transport of potential, metric, scalar kinetic correction, dipoles and rotational operators with matched counterterms. Never shift only frequencies or the potential.
A local quartic jet does not qualify a global XH profile, LAM surface or mixed resonance. Preserve the finite analytic-fit acquisition protocol for global DVR potentials.
Keep experimental bands out of field construction and numerical acceptance thresholds. Curvature percentage differences flag inspection priorities, not automatic correctness or failure.

Bind input/output contents and protocol with SHA256, reject duplicate update identities and mismatched references, keep previous artifacts immutable. New physics or acceptance rules require a new approved protocol version.
Accept a complete symmetric acquired Hessian in the exact frozen frame, with reference and content identities. Replace target minus current once, including offdiagonal terms.
The complete gradient and full acquired Hessian must be supplied together. Do not infer unacquired offdiagonal entries from zero placeholders.
Preserve F0 and source F3/F4; electronic reference energy offsets are supplied separately to the spectral model.
Retain all v1 stationarity, coordinate-jet, joint metric/property transport, provenance and finite-acquisition gates.
coordinate_policy: Same-origin complete frozen normal directions; explicit forces, derivative order, units and coordinate hashes. No silent recentering or tensor rotation.
backend_policy: Pure assembly from acquired data. No scheduler, electronic acquisition, dense numerical cascade or automatic spectral qualification.
